description: pnpm updates for Happy Parent. Pull requests open Friday night into Saturday morning (Europe/Warsaw) and are ready before 07:00. Automerge is off. Pull request bodies include release notes.

packageRules.description: Do not bump engines.node on minor or patch. A major Node engine update is its own pull request.
Next.js majors move with React, react-dom, their type packages, and eslint-config-next. Minor and patch stay in the single non-major group.
Tailwind majors move together. Minor and patch stay in the single non-major group.
Terra Draw majors move with the MapLibre adapter. Minor and patch stay in the single non-major group.
